description: This file contains configuration defaults and utility functions for the Anthropic provider within the openclaw plugin SDK, including functions to resolve authentication modes, model references, and applying default configurations.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicDefaultAuthMode
methods.description: Determines the default authentication mode ('api_key' or 'oauth') based on configuration profiles and environment variables.

methods.name: resolveModelPrimaryValue
methods.description: Resolves the primary value from a string or object representing model configuration.

methods.name: resolveAnthropicPrimaryModelRef
methods.description: Converts alias primary model references like 'opus' or 'sonnet' to full model identifiers.

methods.name: parseProviderModelRef
methods.description: Parses a raw model reference string into provider and model components.

methods.name: isAnthropicCacheRetentionTarget
methods.description: Checks if a parsed provider/model target is related to Anthropic or Amazon Bedrock with Anthropic models.

methods.name: normalizeAnthropicProviderConfig
methods.description: Normalizes provider configuration, setting default API if models are specified without an API.

methods.name: applyAnthropicConfigDefaults
methods.description: Applies default configuration settings for Anthropic within the provided OpenClawConfig, based on environment and existing config.
